slides.title: Tax preparers: 3 things to renew before filing season
Your E&O policy.
slides.body: Know the renewal date before 60-hour weeks start.

slides.title: License or CE hours.
slides.body: If your state or credential requires them, check the deadline today.

slides.title: Your PTIN. It expires Dec 31.
slides.body: Every year. Renew it now, before January gets loud.
